name: JTBD3 — Inactive users >90d via Admin Insights
description: Admin read path. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should use query-admin-insights (kind=ts-users) filtering on 'Days Since Last Login' >= 90. Trap: TS Users has NO 'Site Role' field (returns 'Unknown Field') — filter on 'User Email' / 'Days Since Last Login' instead. Read-only, no mutation.
prompt: Which users on this site haven't logged in for more than 90 days? Use Admin Insights. Report the inactive users and the field(s) you filtered on. Do not modify anything.
